description: This file defines the CopySelection2DWorker class, a SwingWorker subclass used for copying a selection within a 2D table component in a Java Swing application. It interacts with UI components and performs background operations related to copying selections.

classes.name: CopySelection2DWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker subclass responsible for copying the selection from a Table2D object in the background.

methods.name: CopySelection2DWorker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker with a Table2D instance.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the copying of the table selection in the background thread.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Resets the cursor of the window and table components after the background task has completed.
